jobs.title: Solution Advisor - SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success - UK (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

The official recruitment begins September 2026. By applying to this pipeline position, you have the option to get in contact with us early in the application cycle for our SAP Academy for Customer Success Program starting March 2027. We will host info sessions about the Program in the months ahead

The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.

Who You’ll Become

A Solution Advisor works closely with our customers and prospects to identify and solve business challenges and meet their strategic objectives using SAP solutions. As part of the sales team, a Solution Advisor is the “subject matter expert” responsible for the functional and technical knowledge within the sales cycle. A Solution Advisor provides deal support by participating in discovery sessions, executive meetings and presentations and delivers software demonstrations that help the customer understand SAP’s unique value proposition. In addition to deal support, the Solution Advisor participates in marketing events to generate demand, leads Design Thinking sessions, and collaborates with the broader sales team to identify whitespace opportunities at existing accounts.

What You’ll Do

As a Solution Advisor within the SAP Next Gen - Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to: 

Successfully complete a 10-month program that strengthens the foundation for a successful customer-facing career at SAP.
Participate in experiential learning opportunities with colleagues from all over the world and acquire a wide variety of business, industry and SAP solution skills while working with emerging and cutting-edge technologies.
Receive on-the-job training under the mentorship of a senior Solution Advisor colleague while working with our customers to gain real world experience and acquire the skills necessary to help guide our customers through their Digital Transformation journey.   

The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and give you the professional experience to serve our customers. We offer full-time employment from day one with practical learning applications for your role. After successful completion of the program, you are expected to lead customer discovery sessions and survey activities to uncover business challenges and opportunities for innovation. You will create and deliver high impact and engaging software demonstrations that compel the customers to select SAP over other competitive offerings. You will also provide demand generation support through marketing events and deal execution support by responding to request for proposals. 

Solution Advisory Focus Areas

SAP SuccessFactors (Human Capital Management - HCM) - Knowledge in core HR and payroll, talent management, employee experience management, HR analytics, workforce planning, and sales performance management.
SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) & SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) - Knowledge in database and data management, analytics, application development and integration, intelligent technologies, and AI. Understanding of Integration, Application, Data, Infrastructure, and Security technology domains.
SAP Customer Experience (CX) - Knowledge of e-commerce, sales, customer service, and marketing processes.
SAP Supply Chain Management (SCM) - Knowledge in Supply Chain, Asset Management, Manufacturing, Logistics, or Product and Project lifecycle
management.
SAP Finance & Spend Management (F&S) – Procurement,

What You Bring

2-3 years of professional experience with a strong foundation in technical and business processes, exposure to relevant technologies/solutions, and customer-facing skills.
Technical and business process knowledge, combined with hands-on experience using relevant technologies and industry-standard tools to support solution delivery and operational efficiency.
A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally.
A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results.
An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI.
Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries.
Proficiency in English to engage with our global and local network.
AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering)
A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Strong problem-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.

About SAP Academy For Customer Success 

The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.

Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands-on experience with world-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.

#SAPAcademyforCustomerSuccess

#SAPNextGen

SAP Next Gen
is our global experience for students and early talent (0–3 years of professional work experience). Being a part of the Next Gen community provides access to a supportive global network, tailored development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to high-impact projects across the business.

SAP’s employees across different regions are enabled to do their best job with the right mix of office and remote work according to country-specific guidelines and regulations. In general, our hybrid work setup
consists of three days a week in the office or on-site with customers or partners.

We are planning a practical and immersive portion of our program, which will likely involve participants spending four (4) weeks, spread across two trips, in San Ramon, California.
This experience is designed to provide unparalleled hands-on learning and networking opportunities.

During intensive phases of the program, it is critical that all participants are fully engaged and present to ensure maximum learning and success. As such, vacation will not be approved during some critical times of the program.

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

Element was founded by the team behind the Matrix protocol, a groundbreaking project redefining how the world communicates through open, secure and decentralised messaging.

The mission behind Matrix is simple but powerful: make messaging as open and accessible as email. That means giving people and organisations the freedom to choose where their data is hosted, enjoy truly private conversations, and stay in control of their communications.

Today, Element helps major organisations run Matrix securely at scale, from the French, German and British governments to international institutions like NATO and the UN.

Our Values.
We care about the greater good
We work together in the open
We are proud of how we serve our customers
We are ambitious and iterate rapidly

Responsibilities What we’re looking for.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proven experience in customer-facing roles, ideally serving enterprise or government clients.
Professional-level English (C1+).

Bonus points if you also have:
German language skills (C1+).
Account Management experience including dealing with renewals and contracts
Familiarity with decentralised systems, open source software, VoIP, or end-to-end encryption.
Knowledge of mobile platforms (iOS, Android) and mobile device management.
Existing security clearance 

Requirements The impact you’ll make.

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Element, you’ll lead the post-sale customer relationship, ensuring our customers achieve tangible value from our products and services. You’ll be measured by customer satisfaction, adoption, and retention, working across functions to help customers meet their business objectives while championing their needs within Element.

You will collaborate closely with:
Pre-Sales Team (Account Executives and Pre-Sales Engineers) to ensure a smooth handover into the post-sales lifecycle.
Account Managers to support renewal and account growth.
Technical Account Managers and the Support Team to resolve technical barriers and drive adoption.
Product Delivery Teams to influence the roadmap and oversee customer-sponsored development projects

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of product, delivery, and customer engagement.

What you'll be doing.

Own the onboarding journey, including customer handover from Sales and the development of tailored onboarding plans.
Deliver customer training sessions and workshops to drive adoption.
Become a product expert, delivering training to drive adoption
Support product provisioning and ensure successful technical rollout (in partnership with Support and TAMs).
Maintain regular customer contact, building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
Capture and share customer insights, ensuring feedback flows effectively into Element.
Act as a customer advocate: Escalate and resolve urgent issues impacting success.
Influence longer-term product roadmap decisions based on customer needs.

Partner with Account Managers on renewals and account growth opportunities.
Track and report on customer outcomes, adoption trends, and satisfaction.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Xelix, we work with some of the world’s largest companies to automate and strengthen their financial controls. Our AI solutions redefine how Accounts Payable teams operate – moving from manual processes to automated, intelligent workflows.

Xelix is a fast-paced scale-up – things move fast and expectations are high. We raised our Series B with Insight Partners in June 2025 and are expanding aggressively. We have a team 150
talented people pulling together to achieve our goals. Everyone is trusted to take ownership, move fast and have a meaningful impact. We prioritise personal and professional growth, keep things fun, and love to celebrate a milestone together.

In this role you’ll grow, be challenged and help shape the future of Xelix. If you’re excited about building something special with us, we’d love to hear from you.

About The Role

As the Enterprise CS/Account Management Team Lead,
you’ll be responsible for leading a team of Account Managers who manage our Enterprise customer base. You’ll balance people leadership with hands-on account management, coaching your team to deliver world-class customer experiences, retain and grow Enterprise accounts, and drive measurable business outcomes.

What You’ll Be Doing – Team Management

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Managers.
Drive team performance to achieve renewal, retention, and expansion targets.
Guide your team in developing and executing account plans that promote long-term customer success and revenue growth.
Conduct regular team meetings, deal reviews, and 1:1 coaching sessions to ensure alignment and accountability.
Work cross-functionally with Sales, Services, Product, and Marketing to enhance the customer journey and operational processes.
Analyse account health, identify risk indicators, and implement proactive strategies to mitigate churn.
Report on team KPIs and business metrics, providing insights and recommendations to senior leadership.
Contribute to process improvements, playbook development, and scalable strategies for managing mid-market accounts.

What You’ll Be Doing – Account Management

Manage a select portfolio of strategic accounts to model best-in-class customer engagement.
Build and execute Customer Success Plans (CSPs) with clear outcomes, milestones, stakeholders and value hypotheses.
Quantify, track and communicate value realisation (ROI/business impact), preparing and presenting goals, KPIs and commercial narratives to executive sponsors and C-suite stakeholders.
Develop a deep understanding of each customer’s priorities, operating model, systems landscape, and roadmap, using this to shape account strategy and unlock expansion.
Run proactive account governance (e.g., EBRs/QBRs), ensuring adoption, stakeholder engagement and action plans stay on track.
Monitor customer health and engagement to identify risk early, lead retention plans, and mobilise internal teams to protect and grow revenue.
Identify, qualify and progress upsell/cross-sell opportunities, building business cases, aligning stakeholders, and partnering with AEs/founders where needed to close.
Lead renewals end-to-end: timeline management, commercial negotiation support, stakeholder alignment, and forecasting accuracy.
Triage technical and non-technical issues with urgency and strong judgement, coordinating the right internal resources while keeping customers informed and confident.
Be the voice of the customer internally: capture product feedback, influence prioritisation with evidence, and manage expectations on deliverables and timelines.
Stay close to market trends and the competitive landscape, contributing to strategic initiatives that improve our commercial approach and customer outcomes.

What You’ll Bring

You've spent meaningful time in account management within B2B SaaS and you understand how enterprise renewals and expansions actually get done. You're comfortable owning a commercial number and have competent experience of having pricing conversations.

5+ years of experience in Account Management in a B2B SaaS or technology-driven company.
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience leading a team.
A proven record of achieving or surpassing renewal and expansion targets.
Exceptional communication, coaching, and relationship-building skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities; comfortable working with data to guide decisions.
Experience using HubSpot CRM is highly desirable.
Must have experience with MEDDIC.
A proactive, collaborative approach and the ability to influence cross-functional teams.
Passion for developing people, improving processes, and delivering exceptional customer value.

What We Offer In Return

💰 Competitive salary depending on experience + commission

🏝️ 27 days of annual leave (including 3 days Christmas closing) which increases up to 3 days based on tenure, with the option to roll over, buy or sell up to 3 days

🏡 Hybrid working with two days a week from our dog-friendly Hoxton office

💪 On-site gym and cycle to work scheme

🛍️ Employee discount at over 100 retailers

🏥 Comprehensive private medical & dental cover with Vitality

🍼 Enhanced parental leave pay

📚 Learning & development culture – £1,000 personal annual budget

🌍 We’re carbon-neutral and are working towards ambitious carbon reduction goals

🎯 Lots of team socials & activities

☀️ Annual team retreat

Want to learn more?

About us
Xelix blog
Xelix news
Xelix glassdoor

We believe that people from diverse backgrounds, with different identities and experiences make our company and product better. No matter your background, we'd love to hear from you! And if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you - we're happy to accommodate!

If you're a recruiting agency - we have an existing list of agencies we work with and we are not currently planning on expanding the list. Neither the Talent team nor hiring managers or the Support team will respond to cold outreach.

This is a full-time position, with standard working hours from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

While the exact process may vary slightly depending on the role, our typical interview stages are:

Introductory Call – A short Teams conversation with a Talent Partner to discuss your background and the opportunity.

We strive to make the process clear, efficient, and respectful of your time.

jobs.description:
Sargent & Lundy is seeking a Junior Planner 3 with an instrumentation and controls and/or electrical background to support project and outage execution at the D.C. Cook Nuclear Plant. This role supports work package development, schedule readiness, field coordination, and execution planning within Client’s organization.

The selected candidate will work closely with project managers, schedulers, construction leaders, engineers, test personnel, and station stakeholders to help translate activities into practical, field-ready plans. This is a strong opportunity for an early-career professional who wants to grow planning experience in a nuclear environment while supporting meaningful plant work.

Key Responsibilities

Support development of field-ready work plans and planning packages for baseline work, modifications, corrective actions, and outage scope, with emphasis on I&C and electrical activities.
Assist with online and outage planning activities, including work package assembly, task sequencing, schedule input, and readiness reviews.
Coordinate with project managers, schedulers, construction managers, test engineers, procedure writers, procurement, and station personnel to support efficient execution.
Prepare or update planning documentation, material coordination inputs, status updates, turnover information, and closeout support.
Help verify scope definition, walkdown needs, resource assumptions, schedule constraints, and execution prerequisites for assigned work.
Support work management and outage teams in identifying risks, resolving planning conflicts, and escalating emergent issues.
Maintain alignment with station procedures, quality requirements, configuration control expectations, and owner-directed execution practices.
Build and preserve site knowledge through documentation quality, structured handoff, and consistent coordination with site leadership.
Evaluate and approve material procurement recommendations necessary for the execution of work packages.
Conduct field walk-downs to identify and analyze corrective and preventive maintenance, modification, and surveillance activities.
Collaborate with work management, supply, operations, and engineering to address work package issues and provide input to enhance work package quality.
Define procedures, drawings, equipment, and materials for planned work packages.
Coordinate out-of-service notifications, plant barrier impairments, and permits.
Verify the adequacy and compliance of work instructions with all applicable station procedures.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in the U.S. for this position.

Essential Skills

One of the following qualification paths:
A BS or MS degree in Engineering (from an ABET accredited program) with a minimum of 3 year of industry experience
Two-year associate degree with 3 years of industry experience
Completed apprenticeship program (Journeyman) with 3 year of industry experience

Ability to work in a structured, procedure-driven environment with strong attention to detail.
Basic understanding of work packages, scheduling logic, resource coordination, and execution readiness.
Strong organizational, communication, and follow-through skills.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and the ability to learn site systems and planning tools quickly.
Ability to work on site at D.C. Cook and interface effectively with cross-functional plant and project teams.
Must be able to obtain and maintain nuclear site access.

Preferred Experience

Background in instrumentation and controls, electrical systems, digital upgrades, plant troubleshooting, testing support, or related field execution support.
Prior experience supporting nuclear plant work management, outage planning, maintenance planning, or engineering project execution.
Familiarity with work orders, tagging, clearances, material readiness, procedure use, and turnover processes.
Experience with Primavera P6, Maximo, SAP, or similar planning and scheduling systems.
Exposure to field walkdowns, schedule coordination, testing interfaces, electrical isolation planning, loop checks, point-to-point verification, or construction package support.
Knowledge of nuclear safety culture, quality assurance expectations, and configuration control discipline.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work.

We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools.

Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Data Intelligence
jobs.description:
Lead the Way to Intelligent Banking with Us!

You might not think about what happens behind the scenes when you check your bank balance or deposit a check from your phone, but we do. Every day.

Kinective empowers banks and credit unions to move beyond keeping up with technology to shaping the future of banking. Our platform connects the systems financial institutions rely on, makes their data more useful, and helps their teams act on better information.

We are a fast-growing team built on individual ownership, company-wide collaboration, and setting industry-leading standards. Here, new ideas are encouraged, candid feedback is welcomed, and your growth matters as much as the company’s.

Why This Role Matters

Kinective Data Intelligence brings together data from core banking systems, lending platforms, digital banking, contact centers, marketing systems, cards, and other business applications. It then helps financial institutions visualize and activate that data through reporting, dashboards, workflows, predictive analytics, and role-specific business use cases.

The platform only creates value when customers use it consistently to make better decisions and take action. We are seeking a Customer Success Manager who can help execute and continuously improve that adoption and value-realization motion.

You will help customers move from implementation to sustained usage. You will establish success measures, lead monthly progress and prioritization meetings, coordinate customer priorities with Professional Services capacity, and help customer teams build the habits and capabilities required to realize value from Data Intelligence.

For a customer that owns only Data Intelligence, you will serve as the primary Client Success Manager. For a customer that owns multiple Kinective products, you will serve as the Data Intelligence overlay, partnering with the primary CSM who owns the broader relationship and overall account coordination.

This role is best suited for someone who has driven adoption of a complex data, analytics, business intelligence, workflow, or SaaS platform. Banking experience is valuable, but the ability to change customer behavior and demonstrate measurable value is more important.

What You’ll Own

Data Intelligence Adoption and Value Realization

Build and maintain a measurable adoption and value-realization plan for each assigned Data Intelligence customer.
Translate customer business priorities into target use cases, users, milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes.
Establish adoption baselines and monitor usage, engagement, workflow activity, dashboard utilization, recurring reporting, and other available product signals.
Help customers sequence adoption across Data Intelligence capabilities, including the data lakehouse, Business Intelligence, reporting, dashboards, workflows, predictive analytics, and other applicable modules.
Identify adoption barriers such as unclear ownership, insufficient training, weak executive sponsorship, data-quality concerns, competing priorities, or limited client capacity.
Connect product usage to business outcomes such as growth, operational efficiency, member experience, risk management, profitability, or executive visibility.

Lead a monthly customer meeting that reviews progress from the prior month, confirms adoption and delivery status, identifies risks and decisions, and aligns on priorities for the next month.
Convert monthly discussions into a clear action plan with owners, dates, dependencies, and customer commitments.
Coordinate with the Project Manager and Professional Services team to confirm that proposed priorities fit within purchased or approved PS capacity.
Surface remaining-hours, out-of-scope, sequencing, change-control, or delivery-capacity risks before commitments are made to the customer.
Keep the monthly cadence forward-looking and action-oriented rather than allowing it to become a status-only meeting.

Customer Enablement and Scaled Adoption

Hold office hours, webinars, workshops, and role-based enablement sessions that help customers apply Data Intelligence to real business questions and workflows.
Develop repeatable enablement plays for common personas, use cases, and adoption barriers.
Help customers establish internal champions, super-users, data owners, and executive sponsors who can sustain adoption between Kinective interactions.
Use train-the-trainer approaches when customers have limited internal resources or need to scale knowledge across departments.
Partner with Product, Professional Services, Support, and internal subject-matter experts to improve documentation, training, and customer-facing resources.

Relationship, Health, and Renewal Readiness

Serve as a trusted post-sale advisor to both technical stakeholders and business executives.
Maintain an accurate customer health assessment based on adoption, delivery progress, usage signals, engagement, sentiment, unresolved issues, renewal readiness, and expansion signals.
Identify risk early and lead coordinated recovery plans when customers are not receiving expected value or are not progressing against agreed milestones.
Own renewal readiness for Data Intelligence-only customers and provide the Data Intelligence perspective for multi-product customers.
Prepare and lead value reviews, business reviews, and executive conversations that demonstrate progress, outcomes, open decisions, and the next phase of the customer roadmap.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Data Intelligence Project Managers and Professional Services leads to maintain a shared view of delivery status, adoption priorities, dependencies, remaining hours, and customer commitments.
Partner with Sales on handoff quality, account planning, renewal readiness, and expansion strategy. Sales owns pricing, commercial negotiation, and close.
Work with Support and Product to route issues, close communication loops, and distinguish product defects from configuration, training, data, or process gaps.
Surface qualified expansion opportunities, including additional modules, integrations, workflows, analytics use cases, users, or Professional Services capacity.
Bring customer insights into internal prioritization without overpromising unapproved scope, hours, pricing, or roadmap commitments.
Help mature Kinective’s Data Intelligence customer-success playbook, health model, adoption metrics, and value-review standards.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success Here Is Measured By Sustained Customer Value And Operating Discipline, Not Meeting Volume Alone. You Will Know You Are Winning When

Assigned customers have documented success criteria, adoption baselines, monthly priorities, owners, and next milestones.
Customers progress from implementation into recurring usage of purchased capabilities and intended workflows.
Customers can articulate the business outcomes, decisions, or efficiency gains enabled by Data Intelligence.
Adoption and value trends improve over time, with risks identified and addressed before renewal or escalation.
Monthly priorities are realistic, sequenced, and aligned to available Professional Services capacity.
Renewal readiness is visible early, with clear risks, stakeholders, success evidence, and next actions.
Qualified expansion and additional PS needs are identified and handed to Sales with sufficient customer context.
Office hours, webinars, and enablement programs increase customer capability and reduce reactive one-to-one support.
The Data Intelligence customer-success motion becomes more repeatable, measurable, and scalable.

What You’re Great At

Driving adoption, utilization, and value realization for complex B2B SaaS, data, analytics, BI, workflow, CRM, ERP, or business systems.
Translating technical capabilities into business outcomes and practical operating changes.
Building customer success plans that connect executive priorities to user behavior, product usage, milestones, and measurable value.
Leading structured customer meetings that produce decisions, priorities, owners, and dates.
Balancing customer urgency against Professional Services capacity, scope, hours, and commercial commitments.
Teaching and enabling customers through workshops, office hours, webinars, demonstrations, and train-the-trainer programs.
Using data and customer signals to diagnose adoption risk rather than relying only on relationship sentiment.
Influencing without direct authority across customers, Sales, Product, Professional Services, Support, and Engineering.
Communicating comfortably with CIOs, data and analytics leaders, operations executives, finance leaders, marketing leaders, and frontline business owners.
Creating structure in an evolving product and operating environment while remaining pragmatic about what is available today.

Requirements

Necessary Qualifications and Competencies

3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Enablement, Solutions Consulting, or a related post-sale role in B2B SaaS or technology.
Demonstrated experience driving adoption, utilization, or value realization for a data platform, analytics platform, BI product, workflow platform, CRM, ERP, or similarly complex business system.
Experience working with customers after go-live to establish usage patterns, business outcomes, governance, and continuous improvement.
Demonstrated ability to lead executive and working-level customer conversations.
Experience coordinating customer priorities with implementation, consulting, or Professional Services resources.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Ability to interpret usage, engagement, project, and health data and turn it into a clear customer action plan.
Willingness to become deeply fluent in Kinective Data Intelligence, its modules, integrations, use cases, and delivery model.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with a data lakehouse, data warehouse, modern BI, analytics, data activation, workflow automation, or customer data platform.
Experience with products or ecosystems such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Sigma, dbt, Fivetran, Salesforce, Gainsight, Vitally, or comparable platforms.
Experience building adoption programs, customer academies, office-hours programs, user groups, or role-based enablement.
Experience working with financial institutions, fintech, regulated industries, or other complex, data-rich B2B environments.
Experience managing renewals, identifying expansion signals, and partnering with Sales on commercial outcomes.
Experience operating in a scaling or private-equity-backed SaaS company.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.

Role Guardrails

For Data Intelligence-only customers, this role owns the ongoing CSM relationship and renewal readiness.
For multi-product customers, the primary CSM remains accountable for the overall relationship and cross-product coordination; this role owns the Data Intelligence adoption and value agenda.
This role is not an unbounded technical support resource, replacement Project Manager, or substitute data engineer.
This role coordinates and prioritizes Professional Services work but does not promise unapproved scope, hours, pricing, or roadmap commitments.

Pay, Benefits & Total Rewards

Base salary range: $70,000 - $85,000, plus a 10% annual bonus potential.

OasisLMS is looking for a Director of Customer Success to own and shape how we manage, retain, and grow our customer relationships. This is a senior, hands-on role in a small, flat organization. We are not looking for someone to inherit an established Customer Success playbook or someone whose goal is to build a large team underneath them. The right person will learn our business and customers, determine what a great Customer Success program should look like, and then make it happen.

40% Customer Success & Product Partnership
— keeping customers happy, helping them get more value from OasisLMS, understanding their needs, and working closely with our Product team on customer feedback, pain points, and opportunities.·
40% Renewals & Account Management
— owning renewals, identifying retention risks, and managing required moves to higher user tiers as customer usage grows.·
20% Account Growth
— identifying appropriate opportunities for customers to add products, capabilities, or services that provide additional value.

This is not primarily a sales position. The commercial component is focused on existing customers, with the majority of the role dedicated to retention, relationships, renewals, and customer success. Because we intentionally operate with a lean, experienced team and expect senior employees to take meaningful ownership rather than build layers of management, compensation for this position is designed to be above average for comparable roles.

**This position is based in our Chicago office five days per week and is not remote or hybrid.**

What You’ll Do

·Build and manage a structured Customer Success program, including customer engagement, success plans, health scoring, and KPIs.
· Develop strong relationships with customers and proactively help them achieve their goals with OasisLMS.
· Own the customer renewal process, including identifying potential risks well before renewal and driving renewals through completion.
· Manage customer usage levels and required transitions to higher user tiers when applicable.
· Identify appropriate account growth opportunities, including additional OasisLMS products, AI capabilities, mobile applications, and other enhancements.
· Develop customer education and engagement programs, including webinars, best-practice sessions, and other initiatives.
· Build our Voice of the Customer program, including NPS, customer feedback, and a Customer Advisory Committee.
· Serve as a key connection between customers and our Product team, identifying recurring pain points, product gaps, feature opportunities, and changing customer needs.
· Plan and lead the annual OasisLMS User Group Meeting.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who combines exceptional customer relationship skills with a builder mentality and a willingness to stay hands-on.
The ideal candidate:
· Has Customer Success, Account Management, or similar SaaS experience.
· Has experience working with associations or within the association industry.
· Has worked at a startup, small company, or growth-stage organization.
· Is proactive and comfortable identifying what needs to be done without waiting for detailed direction.
· Can create a strategy and personally execute it.
· Is comfortable owning renewals and having commercial conversations with customers.

What Success Looks LikeIn your first year, you’ll have:

· Established a structured, scalable Customer Success program.
· Built strong, proactive relationships across our customer base.
· Created customer health scoring and improved visibility into account risk.
· Taken full ownership of the renewal process and maintained strong customer retention.
· Successfully managed customer transitions to appropriate usage tiers.
· Established NPS and Voice of the Customer programs.
· Built a consistent customer education and engagement program.
· Created a strong, actionable feedback loop between customers and Product.
· Helped Product better understand customer priorities, pain points, and opportunities.
· Increased customer advocacy, references, and case studies.
· Identified and closed appropriate expansion opportunities within existing accounts.
·  Successfully led our annual User Group Meeting.

Why OasisLMS?

OasisLMS is intentionally different from a traditional corporate environment.We operate with a small, flat team of experienced people who have significant ownership and direct influence on the business. We don't believe every successful leader needs to eventually manage layers of people. This role may remain a senior individual-contributor position as the company grows, and we want someone who finds that appealing. In return, you'll have significant autonomy, direct access to leadership, the ability to influence our product and customer strategy, and compensation designed to reflect the level of ownership we expect.

Fourth is the world’s largest and fastest-growing global leader of end-to-end restaurant and hospitality management technology solutions. We pride ourselves on delivering a world-class SaaS experience for our clients by building long-term partnerships starting from the first phone call. We know our recipe for success at Fourth is our amazing team... and that starts with hiring the right people!

Interested in joining our smart, fun, and talented team?

Position Overview

The Customer Success Manager, Payroll owns adoption, retention, and expansion for Fourth’s large and medium-sized Payroll and PEO accounts — a smaller, higher-complexity portfolio than the general Emerging CSM book. These accounts carry more regulatory exposure, higher payroll run complexity, and greater churn cost per account, so the role trades volume for depth: fewer accounts, deeper payroll/PEO domain expertise, and tighter coordination with Payroll Operations, Tax, and Benefits.

This is a specialist track within the CSM level, not a step up the management ladder — scope, financial authority, and outcomes ownership match the standard CSM tier. What differs is domain: this CSM must be able to distinguish Payroll, PEO, Tax, and Benefits issues correctly, know when something is compliance-critical, and route it through the right channel before it becomes a churn event.

Primary Responsibilities

Customer & Portfolio Ownership
Own an assigned portfolio of ~75–125 large and medium-sized Payroll and PEO accounts across the customer lifecycle — onboarding through renewal.
Define the value moment for each account in payroll-specific terms — first clean payroll run, accurate tax setup, on-time filing, compliant benefits enrollment — and track progress against that objective, not generic usage volume.
Partner with Payroll Operations, Tax, and Benefits teams (not a generic Services team) to monitor onboarding progress and ensure customers hit payroll-specific adoption milestones quickly.
Monitor payroll accuracy rate and filing timeliness as leading indicators — payroll errors in the first 90 days are a high-signal predictor of churn for this segment.
Correctly distinguish Payroll, PEO, Tax, and Benefits issues when triaging customer concerns, and flag anything compliance-critical immediately per the 24-hour escalation SLA — compliance-critical items require Compliance Lead and Legal sign-off before any resolution, not CSM judgment call.

Financial & Commercial Scope
No signing, pricing, or discount authority. The CSM does not negotiate contract terms or approve concessions.
Identify and flag expansion opportunities and renewal risk to the CSM Manager or Sales/Account Management for commercial follow-through.
Flag PEO at-risk accounts with elevated urgency: PEO churn remediation is an active company-level dependency before PEO acquisition can scale, so PEO retention signal on this portfolio carries outsized weight.

Outcomes Owned
Payroll accuracy rate within portfolio.
Time to first clean/successful payroll run.
Filing and compliance timeliness.
PEO account retention within portfolio.
SLA adherence (24-hour triage) and CSAT.

Process, Data & AI Fluency
Identify trends in payroll/PEO-specific customer challenges and suggest improvements to process, documentation, and automation.
Use AI-enabled adoption and health-scoring tools tuned to payroll-specific signals (payroll accuracy, filing timeliness) to surface risk and expansion signal earlier.
Maintain accurate, current records in Salesforce (primary CRM), and Zendesk/NetSuite as needed.
Work cross-functionally with Payroll Operations, Tax, Benefits, Support, and Sales; operate independently with minimal day-to-day supervision.

Key Skills and Competencies

1–3+ years of experience in customer success or account management specifically with payroll, PEO, or HCM accounts — general SaaS CS experience alone is not a substitute.
Working understanding of Payroll and/or PEO fundamentals — wage/hour basics, tax filing cadence, benefits administration — sufficient to distinguish Payroll, PEO, Tax, and Benefits issues correctly when triaging.
Experience supporting large or medium-sized accounts (higher complexity, lower volume) rather than pure high-volume SMB motion.
Comfortable operating under compliance-critical escalation protocols — knows what requires Compliance/Legal sign-off versus what can be resolved directly.
Proficiency in Salesforce; familiarity with Zendesk and NetSuite is a plus.
Comfortable using AI-enabled CS/adoption tooling (health scoring, workflow automation) as part of daily account management.
Exceptional written/verbal communication; able to explain payroll and compliance topics clearly to non-technical customer stakeholders.
Data-driven mindset for interpreting payroll accuracy and filing-timeliness metrics against each customer’s stated objective.

Lead the Way to Intelligent Banking with Us!

You might not think about what happens behind the scenes when you check your bank balance or deposit a check from your phone, but we do. Every day.

Kinective empowers banks and credit unions to move beyond keeping up with technology to shaping the future of banking. Our platform connects the systems financial institutions rely on, makes their data more useful, and helps their teams act on better information.

We are a fast-growing team built on individual ownership, company-wide collaboration, and setting industry-leading standards. Here, new ideas are encouraged, candid feedback is welcomed, and your growth matters as much as the company’s.

Why This Role Matters

Kinective Data Intelligence brings together data from core banking systems, lending platforms, digital banking, contact centers, marketing systems, cards, and other business applications. It then helps financial institutions visualize and activate that data through reporting, dashboards, workflows, predictive analytics, and role-specific business use cases.

The platform only creates value when customers use it consistently to make better decisions and take action. We are seeking a Customer Success Manager who can help execute and continuously improve that adoption and value-realization motion.

You will help customers move from implementation to sustained usage. You will establish success measures, lead monthly progress and prioritization meetings, coordinate customer priorities with Professional Services capacity, and help customer teams build the habits and capabilities required to realize value from Data Intelligence.

For a customer that owns only Data Intelligence, you will serve as the primary Client Success Manager. For a customer that owns multiple Kinective products, you will serve as the Data Intelligence overlay, partnering with the primary CSM who owns the broader relationship and overall account coordination.

This role is best suited for someone who has driven adoption of a complex data, analytics, business intelligence, workflow, or SaaS platform. Banking experience is valuable, but the ability to change customer behavior and demonstrate measurable value is more important.

What You’ll Own

Data Intelligence Adoption and Value Realization

Build and maintain a measurable adoption and value-realization plan for each assigned Data Intelligence customer.
Translate customer business priorities into target use cases, users, milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes.
Establish adoption baselines and monitor usage, engagement, workflow activity, dashboard utilization, recurring reporting, and other available product signals.
Help customers sequence adoption across Data Intelligence capabilities, including the data lakehouse, Business Intelligence, reporting, dashboards, workflows, predictive analytics, and other applicable modules.
Identify adoption barriers such as unclear ownership, insufficient training, weak executive sponsorship, data-quality concerns, competing priorities, or limited client capacity.
Connect product usage to business outcomes such as growth, operational efficiency, member experience, risk management, profitability, or executive visibility.

Monthly Customer Operating Rhythm

Lead a monthly customer meeting that reviews progress from the prior month, confirms adoption and delivery status, identifies risks and decisions, and aligns on priorities for the next month.
Convert monthly discussions into a clear action plan with owners, dates, dependencies, and customer commitments.
Coordinate with the Project Manager and Professional Services team to confirm that proposed priorities fit within purchased or approved PS capacity.
Surface remaining-hours, out-of-scope, sequencing, change-control, or delivery-capacity risks before commitments are made to the customer.
Keep the monthly cadence forward-looking and action-oriented rather than allowing it to become a status-only meeting.

Customer Enablement and Scaled Adoption

Hold office hours, webinars, workshops, and role-based enablement sessions that help customers apply Data Intelligence to real business questions and workflows.
Develop repeatable enablement plays for common personas, use cases, and adoption barriers.
Help customers establish internal champions, super-users, data owners, and executive sponsors who can sustain adoption between Kinective interactions.
Use train-the-trainer approaches when customers have limited internal resources or need to scale knowledge across departments.
Partner with Product, Professional Services, Support, and internal subject-matter experts to improve documentation, training, and customer-facing resources.

Relationship, Health, and Renewal Readiness

Serve as a trusted post-sale advisor to both technical stakeholders and business executives.
Maintain an accurate customer health assessment based on adoption, delivery progress, usage signals, engagement, sentiment, unresolved issues, renewal readiness, and expansion signals.
Identify risk early and lead coordinated recovery plans when customers are not receiving expected value or are not progressing against agreed milestones.
Own renewal readiness for Data Intelligence-only customers and provide the Data Intelligence perspective for multi-product customers.
Prepare and lead value reviews, business reviews, and executive conversations that demonstrate progress, outcomes, open decisions, and the next phase of the customer roadmap.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Data Intelligence Project Managers and Professional Services leads to maintain a shared view of delivery status, adoption priorities, dependencies, remaining hours, and customer commitments.
Partner with Sales on handoff quality, account planning, renewal readiness, and expansion strategy. Sales owns pricing, commercial negotiation, and close.
Work with Support and Product to route issues, close communication loops, and distinguish product defects from configuration, training, data, or process gaps.
Surface qualified expansion opportunities, including additional modules, integrations, workflows, analytics use cases, users, or Professional Services capacity.
Bring customer insights into internal prioritization without overpromising unapproved scope, hours, pricing, or roadmap commitments.
Help mature Kinective’s Data Intelligence customer-success playbook, health model, adoption metrics, and value-review standards.

How We’ll Measure Success

Success Here Is Measured By Sustained Customer Value And Operating Discipline, Not Meeting Volume Alone. You Will Know You Are Winning When

new_jobs.description:
Ready to launch your career in Financial Planning & Analysis and gain hands-on experience that will help shape the future of a growing business?
IQ Ventures is seeking an ambitious, early-career FP&A Analyst
who is eager to build a long-term career in finance. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn the business from the ground up while developing the analytical, technical, and business partnering skills needed to become a successful FP&A professional. You'll gain valuable exposure to financial performance, business operations, and strategic decision-making while working closely with leaders across the organization.

In your first year, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting financial reporting, forecasting, modeling, and business analysis while learning our operations, systems, and key performance drivers. As your knowledge and experience grow, you'll take on increasing responsibility in budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and strategic decision support, ultimately becoming a trusted partner to leadership and helping drive informed business decisions and company growth.

What You'll Do

Initially, You'll:

Maintain and improve recurring financial reports, models, and reporting packages.
Extract, validate, and analyze data from NetSuite and other business systems.
Support monthly financial reporting and performance analysis.
Assist with management presentations, reporting packages, and ad hoc analyses.
Learn the company's operations, products, services, and key financial drivers.
Support weekly and monthly reporting processes to monitor business performance.
Develop reports and analytical tools using Excel and other financial systems.

As You Grow, You'll:

Participate in budgeting and forecasting processes.
Build and maintain financial models to support business planning and strategic initiatives.
Perform variance analysis and identify trends impacting financial performance.
Identify and quantify business risks and opportunities.
Support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis and insights.
Partner with leaders across the organization to improve business performance and profitability.
Help develop Power BI dashboards and enhanced reporting solutions.
Create presentations for budget reviews, forecasting meetings, and leadership discussions.
Support special projects and ad hoc financial analysis as needed.

What We're Looking For

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or a related field required.
0-3 years of finance, accounting, FP&A, analytics, banking, or related internship experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Ability to learn new systems, processes, and business concepts quickly.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable working with assumptions, ambiguity, and evolving business needs.
Positive attitude, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to learn and grow professionally.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information.

Experience with NetSuite or other ERP systems.
Exposure to Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or other data visualization tools.
Banking, financial services, accounting, or analytics experience.
Experience creating reports and presentations for leadership teams.

This position is 100% in-office at our corporate office located in Dublin, Ohio.
Candidates should be comfortable working on-site and collaborating directly with leadership and cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding how businesses work, solving analytical problems, and using data to drive decisions.
